visualCharacteristics: A stack of bordered, collapsible items. Each item shows a question label with a chevron marker; clicking expands to reveal the answer body. The chevron rotates when open.
contentPattern: One row per question/answer pair. Cell 1 = question label. Cell 2 = answer body (paragraphs, lists, links). Category headings are authored as default-content headings preceding each accordion group.
usage: FAQ accordion migrated from the FedEx Custom Critical Owner Operators FAQs page (category-grouped question/answer pairs).
